### Sodium-Ion Findings and Evidence Gaps

Phosphate polyanionic cathode materials for sodium-ion batteries demonstrate long cycling performance in lab evaluations, reaching thousands of cycles across various compositions such as Na3V2\(PO4\)3 and Na3Fe2\(PO4\)\(P2O7\)\. [2](https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.19299)
